newsitem.title: TUNISIA: BDET bank takes Tunis bourse down.
newsitem.headline: BDET bank takes Tunis bourse down.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Friday closed down by 0.48 percent in higher trade boosted by the first market, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 458.36 points, down from 460.59 on Thursady.
Total volume was 2.7 million dinars against 462,753 dinars over the previous session. Turnover on the first market was 2.51 million dinars with 129,437 shares changing hands.
Banque de Developpement Economique de Tunisie dropped 7.88 dinars to 9.04 dinars at the start of computerised trading in the shares, bourse sources said.
Brokers said that with computerised trading there is greater transparency as every price movement is registered. Most computerised shares drop sharply when they make the switch.
Since last October, the exchange has gradually introduced computerised dealing for listed firms and the system now includes 27 out of 31 shares in the index.
Detergents firm SPCD fell 1.98 dinar to 31.7 dinars.
UBCI bank was down 1.28 dinar to 41.62 dinars.
Insurance company ASTREE slid 0.74 dinar to 24.86.

Banque Nationale Agricole edged lower 0.73 dinar to 23.51 dinars with 48,823 shares changing hands. Banque du sud declined 0.68 dinar to 21.99 dinars with the exchange of 14,189 shares. Banque de l'Habitat BHH.TN was down 0.4 dinar to 14.1 dinars. Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie eased 0.32 dinar to 29.68.
Banque de Tunisie won 1.3 dinar to 74.9 dinars.
Chemical firm Al-Kimia was up 0.7 dinar to 44 dinars with 5,042 shares changing hands.
Airline Tunis Air rose 0.4 dinar to 22.76 dinars with the exchange of 3,154 dinars.
UIB was up 0.34 dinar to 11.96 dinars. ($1=1.0947 dinar)
